top_findings.title: Team-name normalization only strips the '-sp' suffix, so state-suffixed clubs never match
top_findings.evidence: data.go:197 teamMatch compares only a==b || TrimSuffix(a,'-sp')==TrimSuffix(b,'-sp'); data uses -RJ/-PE/-MG suffixes, so team_stats('Flamengo') matches zero rows (_factual.json).
top_findings.suggestion: Strip any -<UF> state suffix (or use a canonical-name map), not just -sp.

top_findings.title: Match files concatenated without deduplication, inflating counts
top_findings.evidence: data.go:57-79 LoadStore appends each file's rows unconditionally; 2019 Brasileirao is in two files so counts roughly double (_factual.json: 29 Atletico/Athletico rows vs 2).
top_findings.suggestion: Deduplicate on (date, home, away) with a +/-1 day tolerance before aggregating.

top_findings.title: Standings group by the raw team string, so no canonical club row is produced
top_findings.evidence: server.go:102-107 Standings keys the map on x.Home/x.Away verbatim; variants become distinct rows, yielding factual_accuracy=0.0 (_factual.json).
top_findings.suggestion: Canonicalize the team name (strip state suffix, fold accents) as the map key.
